description:
Aggregate and browse AI coding agent sessions (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, etc.) in one place. Desktop app, self-hosted server, or Docker.

Codeg (Code Generation) is an enterprise-grade multi-agent coding workspace. It unifies local AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex CLI, OpenCode, Gemini CLI, OpenClaw, Cline, etc.) in a desktop app, standalone server, or Docker container — enabling remote development from any browser — with conversation aggregation, parallel git worktree development, MCP/Skills management, chat channel interactions (Telegram, Lark, iLink, etc.), and integrated Git/file/terminal workflows.
This release makes replies smoother to follow, keeps background tasks compact, and improves reliability for Kimi Code and CodeBuddy.
Improved
- Replies flow more smoothly as they arrive, with gradual text appearance and natural transitions between messages, steps, command output and completed results, respecting chat animation and reduced-motion settings.
- Background tasks can collapse to a single line with a task count, while longer lists scroll within a limited height to leave more room for the conversation.
- The activity header follows your chat theme and workspace background, with clearer hover feedback and readable text.
- Updated CodeBuddy to 2.177.1, Kimi Code to 2.4.0, Command Code to 1.88.1 and the ZCode bridge to 0.78.0.
- ZCode supports GLM Coding Plan API keys, using keys saved in the desktop app or configured separately through terminal setup.
- Command Code handles image-heavy conversations more reliably, automatically reducing image payloads or compacting context before retrying oversized requests.
Fixed
- Streaming replies keep consistent paragraph, list and code-block layouts, reducing flicker and sudden shifts as content arrives or the reply finishes.
- Command groups stop appearing as the current step once the reply moves on, while commands running in the background retain their actual status.
- Quickly expanding and collapsing the activity header works reliably, without accidentally selecting its text or opening the copy popup.
- Kimi Code’s plan mode no longer ends unexpectedly at the first tool call, allowing the agent to continue gathering information and preparing its plan.
- Stopping CodeBuddy no longer loses the next queued message or incorrectly marks a completed follow-up reply as cancelled.
